result_revision: uncommitted; user owns staging, commits and pushes
scope: Current-machine server-owned spatial interest, explicit field privacy, deterministic bounded selection, paced atomic publication, measured per-recipient socket-byte budgets and real ordered-stream head-of-line behavior; CPU/sanitizers and protected dependency/package closure.

previous_attempts.reason: All 222 native CPU tests passed on the earlier inputs, but the execution driver marked the attempt FAIL when source changes were detected before its final audit. These test results are preserved and do not qualify the replacement source freeze.

The first Server ASan+UBSan contract check exceeded its unchanged 30-second limit; the other 51 tests passed. Diagnostics isolated repeated mounted-filesystem path resolution. Final qualification uses the corrected checker and bounded Scene probes under a new freeze, retaining the original timeout and acceptance gates.

retained_M02a_archive_review.scope: M02a exact upstream dependency archive/source/license review, not final build qualification

dependency.owner_target: EngineCore private TLS transport; no public Mbed TLS or PSA types

vendored_inputs.pin: Bundled in the verified official release archive
Bundled in the verified official release archive; generated files and nested framework included

dependency.verification: Official release/API digest and tag commit reviewed 2026-10-18. LTS maintenance ends March2029. Official full release archive includes generated files and pinned submodules; GitHub automatic source archives are not equivalent.
dependency.notes: Apache-2.0 option selected from Mbed TLS/TF-PSA dual Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later offer; retain complete license text and embedded permissive notices. Exact regular files are verified before configure and by source closure; 147 symlinks solely under unused PQC test/example directories are intentionally not materialized. No upstream source changes, test/example targets, transitive downloads, package fallback, shared crypto libraries or public TLS types. Config uses fixed16384-byte record buffers; runtime restricts TLS1.3, authenticated server certificates, P256 and AES128GCM/SHA256. No tickets/resumption/early data; account auth belongs to M02b. TCP head-of-line behavior is an explicit provisional local foundation limit.

notes: Root release notes claim TF-PSA1.2.0; bundled CMake says1.1.1; exact bundled commit and full archive authoritative.
Upstream generated files retained; no source patch or target auto-download.
All omitted symlinks are unused PQC examples/tests. All regular source bytes verified on every configure.
Runtime restricts TLS1.3, P256, ECDSA/SHA256, AES128GCM/SHA256; compile config limits record payload16384 and maxintermediateCA4.
IntermediateCA verification limit is not a preparse allocation count. TLS1.3 cert list <65536; assembled handshake additionally limited by fixed input buffer.
PQC disabled in pinned default crypto config.

public_credential_fixture_review.scope: Unchanged 17 explicitly public credential fixtures; retains independent prior review and requires fresh M02d engine behavior qualification.

commands.name: tls-sanitizer-compilation
command:
import hashlib, json, shlex
from pathlib import Path
rows = []
for build in (Path('/work/build-05a-final/server-asan-ubsan'),
              Path('/work/build-05a-final-client/linux-asan-ubsan')):
    path = build / 'compile_commands.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text())
    c_units = [entry for entry in entries if Path(entry['file']).suffix == '.c']
    assert len(c_units) == 116, f'Unexpected TLS C compiler units: {build}'
    for entry in c_units:
        assert '/_deps/mbedtls-src/' in entry['file'], entry['file']
        arguments = entry.get('arguments') or shlex.split(entry['command'])
        assert Path(arguments[0]).name == 'clang-18', arguments[0]
        assert '-fsanitize=address,undefined' in arguments, entry['file']
        assert '-fno-omit-frame-pointer' in arguments, entry['file']
    required = {
        'engine/core/src/net_interest.cpp', 'tests/net_interest_tests.cpp',
        'tests/net_interest_probe.cpp', 'engine/core/src/net_replication.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_replication_wire.cpp', 'tests/core_net_replication_tests.cpp',
        'tests/core_net_replication_wire_tests.cpp', 'tests/replication_probe.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_transport.cpp', 'engine/core/src/net_session.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_session_wire.cpp', 'tests/core_net_mtls_tests.cpp',
        'tests/core_net_session_tests.cpp', 'tests/session_probe.cpp',
    }
    owned = [entry for entry in entries
             if any(entry['file'].endswith('/' + name) for name in required)]
    assert len(owned) == len(required), f'Missing instrumented network units: {build}'
    for entry in owned:
        arguments = entry.get('arguments') or shlex.split(entry['command'])
        assert Path(arguments[0]).name == 'clang++-18', arguments[0]
        assert '-fsanitize=address,undefined' in arguments, entry['file']
        assert '-fno-omit-frame-pointer' in arguments, entry['file']
    rows.append({'build': str(build), 'status': 'PASS',
                 'tls_c_translation_units': len(c_units),
                 'owned_network_translation_units': len(owned),
                 'owned_network_sources': sorted(required),
                 'compiler': 'clang-18', 'sanitizers': ['address', 'undefined'],
                 'compile_commands_sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))

runtime_audit.gcc_base_scope: Ubuntu gcc-14-base contains only directories and documentation, not compiler executables; retained runtime inventory is compared separately.

previous_attempts.reason: Server ASan+UBSan shark.contract exceeded30seconds; all other51 tests passed. Final full qualification uses refrozen corrected sources: bounded Scene metadata probes plus invocation-local path-check memoization, with the original30second limit.

investigation.scope: Stack-sampled unchanged contract checker; this diagnostic does not replace final CTest qualification.
investigation.finding: Repeated filesystem Path.resolve/stat work in local document-link and surface validation over the Windows-mounted source; no source or timeout amendment.

resolved_development_findings: Interest and replication source validation previously called whole-Scene stats before the bounded catalog path. They now obtain the live Region scope and revision through a fields-disabled query with a one-slot scan and one-row limit. A new replication case covers empty/sparse sources and lifetime fencing; final qualification contains 21 replication and 20 interest cases.

The earlier Windows execution completed all 222 native CPU tests successfully but detected source changes before its final audit and recorded FAIL. The entire superseded attempt is retained; none of its measurements substitute for the final source freeze.

The first WSL Server ASan+UBSan qualification timed out in shark.contract at 30.04 seconds while its other 51 CTests passed. Unchanged diagnostic runs passed, but did not replace the failed gate. Repeated mounted-filesystem path resolution was then optimized within each validation invocation and covered by regression checks. Final full Windows/WSL qualification uses the replacement frozen sources and the original 30-second CTest limit.
limits: Trusted complete catalog of at most 128 candidates and 32 visible scene-local poses per recipient; default 16 streams. No global-origin or cross-region transfer; M05 remains.
Only pose is replicated. Names, hierarchy, durable IDs, Scene revisions and arbitrary components remain private. Catalog/observer/visibility policy is trusted server configuration.
Policy edits must be supplied to publish/control before polling transport output. Revocation closes the live session, but already admitted/delivered bytes cannot be recalled.
Two authenticated clients, 32 active visible poses, 128 candidates, 20 Hz source and 10 Hz replication measured locally; this is not the full 16-player/NPC LOCAL-MMO-1 capacity or endurance gate.
Socket counters include TLS overhead but exclude TCP/IP headers. Ordered relay hold/shaping measures HOL; full seeded adversity remains M02e.
Single-owner explicit polling/expiry/disconnect cleanup. Work-unit budgets do not establish a hard platform-independent CPU-time or total RSS bound.
